verdict.rationale: Sift is a fraud-detection SaaS platform, so an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. The evidence documents only REST APIs (Events, Decisions, Score, Workflows, Webhooks), a JS snippet, and mobile SDKs, with no mention of an MCP server or agent connector. Those REST APIs are developer building blocks, not an MCP server, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
